_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score pinned in Complacency band with flat tape and mid fear/greed; diverging ETF/CVD factors block both the upside Disbelief step and a forced downside flush until confirmed.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst firm on Complacency/HOLD/CAUTION; narrative silent on forward phase and only reports intake decline
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d change stays near flat, fear_greed holds 45-55, and ETF flows plus CVD do not establish a trend
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed leaves mid-band with ETF flows and CVD either rebounding together (up into Disbelief) or staying dead while crowded longs unwind (down into Anxiety)
